voScript.text: Your backup camera goes black right when you need it most.
It's not always the camera. Three parts share the blame.
The lens, the wiring through the hatch hinge, or the screen itself.
That wire flexes every single time you open the trunk.
Thousands of open-close cycles later, the copper inside just fatigues.
A flickering picture before it dies is one clue where to start.
Do not guess which part — stop by and we'll take a look.
